thread:
maya: Quick kickoff for Aperture launch SEO ops. Need a minimal owners list for redirects, schema, internal links, webinar gating, and lead routing. Keep it terse.

owen: I can do redirects mapping and the 301 roll. Target Tue EOD. Need legacy URL list from content ops.

jess: I'll take structured data for the webinar and the demo how-to steps. Planning Event + HowTo + potential Course types. Need final URL.

maya: Final URL will be https://www.redwood.com/aperture-launch/webinar (staging first). Jess include registrationAction in Event schema.

sam: Internal linking owner here. Prioritize linking product page -> benchmark narrative -> webinar landing in three pillar posts. Also ensure CTAs are contextual and not repetitive.

owen: Redirect detail: strip utm_* params and 301 canonicalize to clean URLs. Example rule for nginx included in my doc. Will run Screaming Frog after deploy.

jess: Example schema snippet: <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Aperture launch webinar","startDate":"2026-04-15T17:00:00Z","performer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"potentialAction":{"@type":"RegisterAction","target":"https://www.redwood.com/aperture-launch/webinar/register"}}</script>

lina: HubSpot routing: form on webinar page should set property lead_source=aperture-webinar and route to aperture-sdr@redwood.com. Engineer: confirm webhook endpoint.

engineer-bot: HubSpot webhook: POST JSON to /api/hs-webhooks. Example: {"email":"{{email}}","lead_source":"aperture-webinar","utm_campaign":"aperture2026"} We'll add a staging proxy.

maya: Action list: Owen publish redirect map Tue EOD; Jess PR schema Wed AM; Sam update pillar posts Thu; Lina confirm HubSpot routing + test Fri. I'll do final audit Fri afternoon.

owen: I'll flag ambiguous legacy shortlinks for content ops review.

lina: I'll run a test lead and confirm SDR queue and tag assignment.
